info.title: CPARS & Past Performance Volume Generator API
info.description: Stateless AI GovCon Past Performance Volume III & CPARS Narrative Engine. Transforms raw project histories and prior contract notes into Shipley Section L/M Past Performance citations with DoD Source Selection Relevance ratings ('Very Relevant'), Scope/Magnitude/Complexity matrices, FAR 42.1503 5-Factor CPARS justifications, and Context-Challenge-Action-Result narratives.

post.summary: Generate CPARS & Past Performance Volume Citations
post.operationId: Generate CPARS & Past Performance Volume Citations
post.description: Transforms unstructured project descriptions, prior contract summaries, and CPARS evaluation excerpts into Shipley-compliant Section L/M Past Performance Volume III citations. Outputs DoD Source Selection Performance Confidence predictions ('Substantial Confidence'), contract-by-contract Relevance ratings ('Very Relevant'), Scope/Magnitude/Complexity cross-walk matrices, FAR 42.1503 5-Factor CPARS justifications, Context-Challenge-Action-Result narratives, and FAR 15.305(a)(2) relevance gap mitigations.

example.bidder_role_and_context: Prime Offeror submitting 3 Past Performance citations (2 DoD Prime contracts + 1 Federal Civilian Major Subcontractor contract); Volume III page limit is 15 pages total (5 pages per citation).
example.project_history_text:
Contract 1 (Prime): U.S. Space Force SSC Enterprise Cloud Enclave (Contract FA8802-22-C-0019, FFP/T&M Hybrid, $18.4M Total Value, $6.1M/yr, PoP 2022-2025, 34 FTEs, NAICS 541512). Migrated 42 legacy mission applications to AWS GovCloud DoD IL5, deployed Okta/Zero-Trust ICAM for 14,500 users, and operated a 24x7x365 Secret/TS-cleared SOC using Splunk Enterprise Security. CPARS ratings: Exceptional across Quality, Schedule, Cost Control, Management, and Small Business (achieved 99.98% uptime SLA and $420K cloud FinOps cost savings).
Contract 2 (Prime): DISA Defense Enclave Cyber Modernization (Task Order HC1028-23-F-0112, T&M, $13.2M Total Value, $4.4M/yr, PoP 2023-Present, 26 FTEs, NAICS 541512). Engineered automated STIG hardening, Zero-Trust microsegmentation, and Continuous ATO (cATO) pipelines across 8,000 endpoints; reduced critical vulnerability remediation MTTR from 14 days to 18 hours. CPARS: Exceptional in Quality/Management/Schedule, Very Good in Cost Control.
Contract 3 (Major Subcontractor — 40% workshare): DHS CISA National Cyber Sensor Analytics (Contract 70RSAT21D00000044, CPFF, $9.6M Subcontract Value on $24M Prime Award, PoP 2021-2025, 19 FTEs). Led 24x7 Splunk SOAR playbook automation and high-volume threat telemetry ingestion (12 TB/day).
example.rfp_section_l_m_requirements: SOLICITATION FA8726-26-R-0054 (USAF Enterprise Cloud & Zero-Trust SOC Modernization): Section L.5 Volume III Past Performance: Offerors shall submit up to three (3) recent and relevant Past Performance citations performed within the past five (5) years, each with an annual contract value >= $4,000,000 (or Total Contract Value >= $12,000,000). At least two (2) citations must be performed as a Prime Contractor. Section M.3 Evaluation Criteria (DoD Source Selection Procedures): Past Performance will be evaluated on Recency, Relevance (Scope, Magnitude, and Complexity across PWS 3.1 AWS GovCloud IL5 Migration, PWS 3.2 Zero-Trust ICAM & Microsegmentation, and PWS 3.3 24x7x365 Cleared SOC & Splunk SIEM Operations), and Quality of Performance (CPARS / PPQ ratings) to assign an overall Performance Confidence Assessment ('Substantial Confidence' highest).
